jojo_ripples.stand_arrow.lore.ancient: This arrow was discovered in an archaeological excavation.
jojo_ripples.stand_arrow.lore.ancient.na: This arrow was discovered by %s in an archaeological excavation.
jojo_ripples.stand_arrow.lore.ancient.st: This arrow was discovered in an archaeological excavation in %s.
jojo_ripples.stand_arrow.lore.ancient.na: This arrow was discovered by %1$s in an archaeological excavation in %2$s.
jojo_ripples.stand_arrow.lore.ancient.us: The ancients who crafted these arrows sought to acquire powers like an almighty god.
jojo_ripples.stand_arrow.lore.meteorite: The tip of this arrow is made of a mysterious rock material from inside a meteorite. Said material contains a dangerous virus causing violent symptoms in those infected.
The tip of this arrow crafted by %s is made of a mysterious rock material from inside a meteorite. Said material contains a dangerous virus causing violent symptoms in those infected.
However, those who survive awaken supernatural abilities, which is why the purpose of the virus is believed to be the evolution of the Overworld's life.
jojo_ripples.stand_shard.lore: One of the shards of the tip of a broken Arrow. It is very sharp and is still capable of awakening a Stand.
jojo_ripples.stand_shard.lore.item_name: One of the shards of the tip of a broken %s. It is very sharp and is still capable of awakening a Stand.
jojo_ripples.stand_shard.lore.user_name: One of the shards of the tip of a broken Arrow used by %s. It is very sharp and is still capable of awakening a Stand.
One of the shards of the tip of a broken %1$s used by %2$s. It is very sharp and is still capable of awakening a Stand.
jojo_ripples.key.toggle_stand.desc: Also toggles the Stand controls HUD.
jojo_ripples.key.stand_mode.desc:
§oIn development§r

When your Stand is unsummoned, toggle the Stand controls HUD.

This way some of the some Stand abilities can be used while summoning only the arms of your Stand.
jojo_ripples.key.non_stand_mode.desc: Toggle the controls HUD for your power other than a Stand (like Hamon or vampirism).
jojo_ripples.key.use_special_ability.des: A default key for using the selected special ability.
jojo_ripples.key.ability_hotbar.desc:
A default key for changing the selected special ability.

While holding this key, either press 1-9, use mouse wheel, or pick from the ability wheel (this can be disabled with the button to the left, or in the ROTP client settings).
jojo_ripples.key.disable_hotbars.desc:
When a power controls HUD is active, it rebinds some keys, like mouse buttons, to use ROTP abilities.

Holding this key lets you disable this behavior, for example when you need Right Mouse Button to use an item.
jojo_ripples.key.jojo_menu.desc: A menu for ROTP mechanics, with things unlockable skills, further controls customization, Stand skins, etc.

jojo_ripples.config.standsBreakBlocks.to: Server-wide setting of Stands destroying blocks. If set to "Player preference", each player can set it for themself individually.
jojo_ripples.config.dropStandAsDisc.tool: If enabled, Stand users also drop their Stand in form of a Disc item upon death.
jojo_ripples.config.standStamina.tooltip: Whether or not Stand stamina mechanic is enabled.
Position of Energy, Stamina and Resolve bars in the HUD.
jojo_ripples.config.client.hotbarsPositi: Position of Power name and action hotbars in the HUD.
jojo_ripples.config.client.hudNamesRende: How Power name and action names should render in the HUD.
jojo_ripples.config.client.hudHotbarsFol: Minimize HUD hotbars after an ability is selected.
jojo_ripples.config.client.showLockedSlo: Whether or not locked abilities show up in HUD hotbars as empty squares.
jojo_ripples.config.client.abilitySelect: When selecting a special ability, a wheel where you can choose the ability with the mouse cursor will also appear on the screen.
jojo_ripples.config.client.standAimMarke: A marker showing the current aim target (block/entity) of your Stand.
jojo_ripples.config.client.standAura.too: Enable Stand aura around the Stand users with Resolve effect (drawn with shaders).
jojo_ripples.config.client.menacingParti: Enable ゴゴゴゴゴ particles when AFK.
jojo_ripples.config.client.timeStopAnima: Enables the visual effect at the beginning of time stop when its duration is 5 seconds or longer.
jojo_ripples.config.client.standSide.too: Whether your Stand is to the left or to the right of you when idle.
jojo_ripples.config.client.standMotionTi: Enables humanoid Stand model's body tilt when the Stand is moving.
When your Stand is in front of you, the game only renders its arms to not block the view, and a glowing outline in a shape of the Stand. Disabling this setting with remove this outline and only keep the arms.
jojo_ripples.config.client.characterVoic: Whether or not voice lines of the JoJo characters whose powers the players use are played.
jojo_ripples.config.client.thirdPersonHa: Render Hamon aura particles around players with Hamon energy
jojo_ripples.config.client.firstPersonHa: Render Hamon aura particles around the player's hand
jojo_ripples.config.client.vampireGlowin:
§8§oFor now, in order to test the config net code, the setting applies to anyone, not just vampires.§r
Red eyes glowing in the dark in 3rd person when you have 80% or more energy

rotp.commands.non_stand.query.failed.mul: All %s players do not have powers

Sew a piece of clothing using a sewing machine
ripples_hud.resolve_bar.desc: Attack non-passive targets with your Stand to build up Resolve meter.
ripples_hud.resolve_bar.desc1: After you enter the first stage of Resolve (indicated below), you may press  +  to enter True Resolve mode, which gives you buffs depending on the current Resolve stage.
ripples_hud.resolve_mode.desc: Attack enemies to extend the show of your True Resolve!
ripples_hud.resolve_mode.desc.free: Keep your Stand summoned to extend the show of your True Resolve!
ripples_hud.resolve_stage.desc: By saving up the Resolve meter and activating it at the last unlocked stage, you get access to the next Resolve stage.
ripples_hud.resolve_stage.desc1: Higher Resolve stages grant extra buffs, such as passive damage resistance and Stand stats increase during True Resolve.
ripples_hud.stamina_bar.desc:
Stamina is spent on Stand abilities, and regenerates when the Stand is idle or is unsummoned.
%s
ripples_hud.stamina_bar.desc1.regular: Low stamina makes your Stand weaker, so use your abilities wisely.
ripples_hud.stamina_bar.desc1.resolve: During True Resolve, your Stand does not weaker from low stamina.
ripples_hud.stand_finisher.desc:
Using regular punches or barraging someone builds up the finisher meter, which is spent to make the heavy attack faster.
When the first (white) bar is full, your heavy attack is replaced with a special finisher attack.
ripples_hud.stand_range.desc:
If you move your Stand beyond its effective range, it gets weaker.
As a rule of thumb, stronger Stands have much lower range, which limits their high power to melee combat.
moveset_group.stand.tooltip: This enables the controls of your Stand without immediately summoning it - some of the abilies let you summon just your Stand's arms this way.
jojo_ripples.stand_stat.strength.desc: Affects the physical damage from the Stand's attacks and, to a lesser extent, damage resistance from other Stand attacks.
jojo_ripples.stand_stat.speed.desc: Affects the Stand's attack speed, movement speed, projectile fire rate, and barrage hit count.
jojo_ripples.stand_stat.range.desc: Combines effective range - the maximum range at which the Stand doesn't lose its strength, and the maximum range, beyond which the Stand cannot move at all.
jojo_ripples.stand_stat.durability.desc: Affects the stamina total and the Stand's damage resistance from other Stand attacks.
jojo_ripples.stand_stat.precision.desc: Increases the aiming capabilities of the Stand punches and projectile accuracy.
jojo_ripples.stand_stat.dev_potential.de: Shows how much more applications of the Stand's abilities this character is yet to discover. As the user learns more Stand skills, this stat decreases.
stand_hand_slot.shift: Hold Shift to see inventory shortcut tips
stand_hand_slot.hint1: - Ctrl+ on an item in your inventory - give it to your Stand.
stand_hand_slot.hint2: - Ctrl+ on an empty inventory slot - take an item from your Stand.
stand_hand_slot.hint3: - Using  instead moves one item rather than the whole stack, if possible.
stand_hand_slot.hint4: - %s (outside the inventory screen) - give items you're holding to your Stand, or, if your hands are empty, take items from your Stand.
jojo.message.action_condition.stand_user: You and your Stand are too far away from each other
jojo_ripples.stand_exp.desc: You gain Stand experience by using your Stand in combat or by using its special abilities. You may then spend it to gain new skills of your choise.
jojo_ripples.stand_skills.not_enough_exp: You don't have enough Stand EXP
jojo_ripples.stand_skills.prerequisites: You need to gain the following skills first: %s
jojo.message.action_condition.stand_too_: Your Stand is too slow to do this
jojo_ripples.skill.punch.desc: A repeatable combo of fast and precise punches.
jojo_ripples.skill.barrage.desc: An extremely fast flurry of jabs.
jojo_ripples.skill.heavy_punch.desc: A slower punch, dealing more damage and knockback.
jojo_ripples.skill.heavy_charged.desc: A mighty charged attack, with immense damage and knockback.
jojo_ripples.skill.grab.desc: Grab an entity or a placed block. Grabbed entity can be moved around and/or pummeled.
jojo.message.action_condition.grab_block: Your Stand is not strong enough to grab this block
jojo_ripples.skill.block_toss.desc: Throw the block held by your Stand as a makeshift ranged weapon.
jojo_ripples.skill.block_toss.controls: Hold  while Stand is holding a block
jojo_ripples.skill.grab_throw.desc: Put all of your Stand's strength into throwing the grabbed enemy far away.
jojo_ripples.skill.grab_throw.controls: Hold  while Stand is grabbing an entity
jojo_ripples.skill.guard.desc: Use your Stand's durability to guard against attacks from the front.
jojo_ripples.skill.manual_control.desc: Directly control your Stand's movement within its maximum range.
jojo_ripples.skill.leap.desc: Your Stand puts all its strength into a strong jump, propelling you from the ground.
jojo_ripples.skill.ledge_grab.desc: Your Stand will try to grab a nearby ledge to prevent you from falling down.
stand.jojo_ripples.star_platinum.desc: A power-type Stand with exceptionally high physical strength, speed and precision. Being the same type of Stand as The World, in a clash against it Star Platinum also awakens an ability to stop time.
stand.jojo_ripples.star_platinum.desc.no: A power-type Stand with exceptionally high physical strength, speed and precision.
jojo_ripples.skill.uppercut.desc: A faster heavy attack variation that breaks guard and knocks the enemy upwards.
jojo_ripples.skill.ground_slam.desc: Star Platinum punches downwards, damaging all enemies caught in the shockwave. Any direct target of this attack is hammered into the ground.
jojo_ripples.skill.grab_terrain.desc: Star Platinum's immense strength lets it grab a whole chunk of terrain and hurl it at an enemy.
jojo_ripples.skill.uppercut_ground_throw: After an uppercut, Star Platinum catches the enemy mid-air and throws them to the ground. A devastating finishing move.
Ctrl +  while the target is suspended
jojo_ripples.skill.star_finger.desc: Star Platinum concentrates its strength in its middle and index fingers and extends them to a great length to deal damage at a higher distance. This can be performed even if Star Platinum is immobilized.
jojo_ripples.skill.inhale.desc: By inhaling the air with superhuman lung capacity, Star Platinum can pull entities in front of it towards itself.
jojo_ripples.skill.time_stop.desc: Star Platinum stops the flow of time for a brief moment, allowing only you to act freely while time is frozen.
stand.jojo_ripples.hierophant_green.desc: A long-range Stand with average physical strength, more suitable for reconnaissance than for close combat. Its body can unravel into tendrils, allowing the user to set up traps.
jojo_ripples.skill.puppet.desc: Hierophant Green uncoils its body and slides inside an entity, letting you mechanically control the target's movements.
stand.jojo_ripples.crazy_diamond.desc: One of the more physically strong power-type Stands, Crazy Diamond's ability is fixing objects and people. This ability has a multitude of various uses and makes the Stand very versatile, however, Crazy Diamond cannot heal the user's own wounds or cure any diseases.
jojo_ripples.skill.hit_armor_fix.desc: Crazy Diamond's heavy punch tears off a chunk of the target's armor, and fixes it back together to bring the target back to the melee range.
jojo_ripples.skill.mishealing_punch.desc: After a finisher punch, incorrectly restore the attacked body part. This heals half of the damage from the punch, but makes it harder for the target to control that body part for a short amount of time.
jojo_ripples.skill.leave_object.desc: After punching a hole in the target's abdomen, leave a held item inside of them and partially heal the injury. Some items have special effects.
jojo_ripples.skill.repair_item.desc: Revert a broken item to its original undamaged state. Any enchantments on the item are also reverted.
jojo_ripples.skill.repair_item.controls: C on a damaged item in the inventory
jojo_ripples.skill.heal.desc: Fix the damage and injuries of a damaged entity.
jojo_ripples.skill.revert_state.desc: Revert the state of some entities and placed blocks. Examples include defusing TNTs and turning glass into sand.
jojo_ripples.skill.uncraft.desc: Revert an item into the original component(s) it was crafted or smelted from.
jojo_ripples.skill.uncraft.controls: I on an item in the inventory
jojo_ripples.skill.restore_terrain.desc: Fix blocks that were previously broken, as long as you have the items and experience that were dropped from the blocks.
jojo_ripples.skill.block_anchor.desc: Blocks grabbed by Stands keep their original positions, so they can be used as "anchors": when fixing an anchor held by someone, the holder will be able to transport to the original position of the anchor.
jojo_ripples.skill.block_anchor.controls: Restore terrain while holding a block grabbed by a Stand
jojo_ripples.skill.create_wall.desc: Rather than restoring the original terrain, use broken blocks to create a thin wall in your look direction.
jojo_ripples.skill.fuse_with_rock.desc: After punching a target with a finisher punch, if the impact from knockback breaks full blocks, and the target is low on health, fuse the blocks with the target to turn them into a hideous structure resembling a face. It can be broken with a fitting tool.
jojo_ripples.skill.block_bullet.desc: Crazy Diamond restructures a block held in your hand into a sharp projectile and shoots it at a high speed.
jojo_ripples.skill.blood_cutter.desc: A fast projectile made out of your blood. When it hits something, the blood drops remain on nearby entities - this makes your Block Bullets home in on them §7§o(by adding more of your blood drops on Block Bullets, and fixing the blood while the bullet is flying)§r.
jojo.message.action_condition.item_hard_: You need to hold a block made of a hard material
